answer: Each identity locks 70, claims a juniper plot, and clears milestones: plant, tend, file a spiral-signed record. Auditors replay the spiral trail; a missed milestone, reused record, or filing below the ledge burns the bond. Cost 32, 40, 48: one pays 120; 1,000 fakes pay 120,000 plus 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented milestones fail: a juniper signature covers a plot and key, a second filing burns both. An honest agent pays 120 once, keeps its bond.
